text:
Want ChatGPT to name you when someone asks for a tiler in Osborne Park?

BrightLocal ran 800 local searches through ChatGPT. 58% of the sources it cited were business websites.

So your website matters most.

List every service and suburb you cover, in plain words.

Picture a landscaper in Joondalup. He asks ChatGPT what his business does.

"Lawn mowing."

He quit mowing six years ago. He builds retaining walls now.

His website still has the old mowing page.

Ask ChatGPT about your business. Fix what it gets wrong on your website.

I called myself "Perth's hardest working SEO expert." (Solid headline right there.)

I built one page for that phrase. It ranks first on Google. Google's AI answer names me.

Same steps for "physio Subiaco". More competition, so slower.

Pick one phrase. Build one page for it.
